blocked_metrics.complete_causal_ancestry: Bounded roots may truncate; only exact trigger chains are proven.
blocked_metrics.new_edge_delay_and_delay_reduction: No proposed edge configuration; hop reduction is analytical only.
blocked_metrics.source_intrinsic_state_delta_compatibili: Source pre/post update states not retained.
blocked_metrics.source_local_candidate_availability: No downstream observation return channel retained.
blocked_metrics.task_utility_and_efficacy: No intervention/task scoring authorized; state deposition is not utility.
blocked_metrics.usable_reachable_candidate_edges: No admission, locality validation or counterfactual routing authorized.

experiment.authorization_handoff_byte_identity: separate exact CRLF checkout and LF Git-blob pins

candidate_opportunity_precursors.ordering: fixture order, destination emission order, source emission order

numerical_policy.historical_timestamp_exception: timestamp tolerance only on queue arrival and relay trajectory; canonical emission times, prior_clock and elapsed remain exact

replay.equality: canonical bytes equal, including float bits
replay.replay_blocker: initial records and digest immutable; separate blocker

experiment.verdict_rule: support requires genuine calibrated destination integrated emission

fixture_source_provenance.audit_boundary: x+y is stored only as a derived audit value with a separate derived_audit_sha256; neither audit values nor audit digests enter canonical fixture identity.
fixture_source_provenance.binary64_encoding: struct.pack('>d', float_value).hex(), exactly 16 lowercase hexadecimal characters in big-endian IEEE-754 binary64 encoding.
fixture_source_provenance.canonical_serialization_format: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, ordered canonical raw-row list, finite numbers only
fixture_source_provenance.data_access_boundary: Only generated training point sequences were read. Labels, class metadata, evaluation streams, and neural outcomes were not read.

point_generation_parameters.evaluation_seed: 22017 + seed; evaluation points are not consumed

materialization_comparison.scope: Repeated materialization was verified only in the recorded environment; this does not establish cross-platform or environment-independent determinism.
materialization_comparison.statement: Post-publication independent fixture materialization verification produced identical canonical fixture bytes/digests under the declared environment.

fixture_source_provenance.ordering_rule: for seed in ascending order, preserve the sequence order returned by _training_point_sequences(seed), identified as c{seed:02d}-{sequence_index:03d}
fixture_source_provenance.point_representation_format: JSON decimal strings plus Python hexadecimal float strings for x, y, t; canonical identity includes only raw point metadata and the corresponding binary64 bits.

post_publication_independent_materializa.scope: Same declared runtime environment only; no cross-platform determinism claim.
post_publication_independent_materializa.statement: Post-publication independent fixture materialization verification produced identical canonical fixture bytes/digests under the declared environment.

runtime.dependency_policy: Point generation uses Python standard-library random/math and repository modules; no external package is used to generate points.

fixture_source_provenance.serialization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, ordered row list, finite numbers only; raw values represented in identity as exact 16-character big-endian IEEE-754 binary64 hex.

rules.units: retained logical time and scalar signed drive
